Payout of 14 August is short ₹610.97.
The bank credited ₹4,81,501.83 against an expected ₹4,82,112.80. 22 orders sit in this payout. This is consistent with refund rfnd_000027 of ₹610.95, issued 25 July against payment pay_000228. Refunds are deducted from the cycle that processes them, not the cycle of the original sale, so a payout can be reduced by a refund against a much earlier purchase.
Suggested action: verify rfnd_000027 in the refund report and confirm it was deducted from this payout. The amounts match, which is not proof of cause -- rfnd_000027 is booked to another cycle, so the link is not confirmed.
